explanation: The statement is about library-specific objects (`TauCeti.indecProjRepBasis`, `TauCeti.indecProjRepArrowHom`, `TauCeti.indecProjRep`, `Paths.of` of the path category of a quiver, and `Quiver.Path` composition). None of these exist in Mathlib (`indecProjRep`/`indecProjRepArrowHom` have no hits in the Mathlib tree), so no Mathlib declaration can state this result. The only plausible generic Mathlib ingredients are `Basis.repr_apply_eq` (LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean), `Basis.ext`, `LinearMap.congr_fun` and `Finsupp.mapDomain_single`; using them still requires the library's own basis-image lemma `indecProjRepArrowHom_app_basis` and a two-step linear-map extensionality argument, i.e. more than one or two lines. I also searched for a general 'repr of a basis-mapped linear map is a mapDomain' lemma (`Basis`/`Finsupp.mapDomain`, `repr_mapDomain`, `lmapDomain ... ∘ₗ repr`), finding only unrelated cotangent/standard-smooth and finite-presentation uses of `lmapDomain`.
